UPDATE!
🛫 5 new aircraft variants!
🚨 16 new events including wingtip & accelerated stalls
🚔 New police car
👷 Openable cargo doors
🗺️ New map
+80 other improvements

Will you survive an emergency landing? From epic engine failures to fierce in-flight fires to unsurvivable mid-air collisions, with 280+ different emergencies no two rounds are alike!
🛬 Survive plane crashes
🛟 Rescue survivors
🚒 Extinguish fires
👮🏻 Seal the wreckage
🧑🏻‍✈️ Fly the plane to safety
📚 Learn about aviation
🏆 Collect 230+ badges
🪙 Earn coins to get all 230+ permanent perks including 40+ vehicles

With:
✈️ 11 unique aircraft in 30 variants
⛈️ Realistic spatial weather
📛 76 airlines!
🎨 190+ original liveries
🏜️ Procedural maps with 10 biomes & many props
🔶 Functional FDR & CVR
🦺 Safety features: oxygen masks, evacuation slides & rafts, crash axes, audible PA, etc.

Available on PC/mobile/tablet/console! VC enabled.

⚠️ Beta = error-prone ⚠️ Play on a free private server for a smoother experience
